what: wave-75 75-d D* crossing-time surface (P_SPLIT x transport) + 600-gen H1 extension — stamped pre-expectations
entropy_protocol: w74_stream UNCHANGED: blake2b('w74-chaotic-fallback:'+arm+':'+rep) -> PCG64, fast-forward 4g; arm encodes grid cell (p{P_SPLIT}_t{T}; 600-gen arm 'base600')
censoring: no sustained NBHD>=3/20-gen crossing by NGEN -> D_star_stat = NGEN+1 (241 surface); censored fraction reported

S1.expected_range: p=0.01 ~100-241 (censor risk at low T); p=0.08 ~10-40

S2.note: 74-c H2 b=0.026 says transport saturates; expect diminishing returns 2.0->4.0

S3.claim: interaction — one dial flattens at the high end of the other
S3.expected: R1_high <= 0.5*R1_low (P_SPLIT effect flattens at high T)

S4.grounding: 74-c per-gen CSV: H_pool peaks ~gen 100-150 (1.28-1.38) then erodes (all 3 late slopes negative; rep0 margin already -0.116)

verdict_rules.S1: pooled spearman(D*,P_SPLIT) n=32 < 0, t-approx p<0.10, AND >=3 of 4 per-T-level rhos (n=8) < 0
verdict_rules.S2: pooled spearman(D*,T) n=32 < 0, t-approx p<0.10, AND >=3 of 4 per-P_SPLIT-level rhos (n=8) < 0
verdict_rules.S3: R1_low>0 and R1_high<=0.5*R1_low, OR R2_low>0 and R2_high<=0.5*R2_low (ranges of mean-D* matrix)
verdict_rules.S4: margin >= 0.05 PASS else INCONCLUSIVE->FAIL upgrade + plateau = mean H_pool(300-600)

runtime_guard: if full 35-run grid exceeds ~25 min wall, halve grid along transport axis (keep T in {0.5,2.0}) and BOOK reduction
